Annotation Interface MongoGeoIndexed

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target({FIELD,METHOD,ANNOTATION_TYPE}) @Documented @Inherited public @interface MongoGeoIndexed
Declares a simple MongoDB geospatial index for a property.
Since:
5.0.0
Author:
radovanradic
